about: The release gate's legs: one per-run VM each, run in parallel (tools/release_gate/run_gate.py --leg NAME), then combined (--combine). A release passes only when every leg passes. 'images' are pulled before the unit suite (tests skip without them); every test in a 'must_run' file must run: a skip of one fails the leg.

py3.12.about: test.yml's unit job and its Docker jobs on Python 3.12, plus the hill-climb test alone and the cost matrix, on Ubuntu's Docker (the proven Compose).

py3.13.about: The whole unit suite on Python 3.13, the other Python test.yml runs; it includes the sandbox-install unit files. 0.10.0rc3's own test run failed on exactly this leg.

docker-ce.about: The whole unit suite on Docker CE's current Engine and Compose (bootstrap_vm.sh --docker ce), which users install from get.docker.com. Only a test the lead waives by name for this leg may fail here.
